verdict.rationale: Convex is a backend platform with a dashboard, so an in-dashboard AI assistant is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only external-agent support: an MCP server for AI agents, agent setup prompts, and claims that Convex works well with coding agents. None of it describes an AI assistant built into the dashboard that writes queries, debugs errors, or explains the backend. Adjacent agent tooling does not count toward this story.
